products.name: Dots
products.description: The Tempt Dots are true wireless earbuds with up to 15 hours of continuous playtime and about 100 hours of standby time on a full charge. They use 13 mm dynamic bass drivers for deep bass and clear vocals, connect over Bluetooth for a stable link, and pair quickly with smartphones, tablets, and laptops. They have IPX5 water and sweat resistance, touch controls, Type-C charging, and a lightweight, ergonomic design.

products.name: Boombuddy 120W
products.description: The Boombuddy is a portable party Bluetooth speaker with a 120W DSP amplifier, dual 101mm dynamic drivers, and twin 25mm tweeters for a wide, clear soundstage. Dual bass radiators add low-end depth, and three EQ presets (Normal, Deep Bass, and Rock) tune the sound for music, movies, or podcasts. It runs up to 18 hours on a charge, charges over USB Type-C while playing, and uses Bluetooth 5.3. Two units can be paired in TWS mode for a combined 240W stereo output, and the box includes a karaoke mic.

products.name: Maestro 67W GaN3
products.description: The Maestro is a 20000mAh power bank with 67W GaN3 fast charging through a USB-C PD 3.0/PPS port, plus a USB-A QC 4.0 port for charging a second device at the same time. It includes two built-in Type-C cables, so users can charge without carrying extra cables. A smart digital display shows the exact battery percentage, and multi-layer protection guards against overcharging, overheating, and short circuits. It is aimed at phones, tablets, and laptops such as MacBooks.

products.name: Enigma
products.description: The Tempt Enigma is a portable high-power Bluetooth speaker rated at 30W RMS (60W peak), with two 65mm dynamic drivers and a 65mm passive bass radiator for deep bass. It offers dual EQ modes (Normal and Deep Bass), RGB ambient lighting, and an IPX5 splash-proof woven mesh body. It supports Bluetooth 5.3 with a 10m range, TWS stereo pairing, a built-in microphone for hands-free calls, and up to 12 hours of playback from a 3100mAh battery charged over Type-C.

products.name: Elevate
products.description: The Elevate is a portable, foldable aluminum laptop stand for desks that raises your laptop to an ergonomic viewing angle to help reduce neck and eye strain. It offers six incline positions (14°, 24°, 31°, 37°, 41°, and 43°) and an open-frame design that improves airflow for cooling. Anti-slip silicone pads hold the laptop securely and protect its surface from scratches. The stand is lightweight, folds for travel, and supports laptops up to 5 kg.

products.name: PowerPad
products.description: The TEMPT Powerpad is a slim, lightweight Qi-certified wireless charger with a 15W Type-C PD rating, compatible with iPhone and other Qi-enabled phones. It outputs 5V/1A, 9V/1.2A, and 12V/1.25A, and a QC 2.0 or QC 3.0 adapter is recommended for best performance. IC protection guards against short circuits, overcharging, and over-discharging, and an independent large coil provides a stable magnetic field. Its ABS body is fire resistant and designed for easy portability.

products.name: Flair
products.description: The Tempt Flair is a 10,000mAh MagSafe-compatible power bank with a built-in kickstand for hands-free viewing. It offers up to 22.5W wired charging through its Type-C port, up to 18W from its USB-A port, and 15W magnetic wireless charging. It has a slim, lightweight design, a 4-LED battery indicator, and multi-layer protection against overheating and short circuits. It works with iOS, Android, earbuds, and smartwatches.

products.name: JOOS Mag Mini 10
products.description: The MagMini is a pocket-sized 10,000mAh power bank with 15W magnetic wireless charging for MagSafe-compatible iPhones and Android phones. It also offers 22.5W PD fast charging over USB-C and a built-in Type-C cable. The page also lists support for smartwatches and earbuds.

products.name: Sonic-C
products.description: The Tempt Sonic-C is a wired USB Type-C earphone with a built-in DAC and microphone, requiring no Bluetooth pairing or charging. It uses 12mm dynamic drivers for deep bass and clear highs, and includes a built-in HD mic with noise reduction. In-line controls handle volume, track skipping, and answering or ending calls. The braided, tangle-free cable is rated for up to 10,000 bends.

products.name: Elite 67W GaN3
products.description: A compact 67W GaN3 charger with two USB-C ports for charging several devices at once. A single port delivers up to 67W, and using both splits output into 45W and 22W. It supports PD 3.0 and PPS fast-charging protocols for phones, tablets, and laptops, and includes multiple safety protections and a fire-retardant casing. It weighs about 72 grams and is made in India.

products.name: Rebel Air 5W
products.description: The Rebel Air is a compact portable Bluetooth speaker with a 5W RMS output, a 52mm bass driver, and a passive radiator for deeper bass. It offers Bluetooth 5.4, up to 8 hours of playtime, Type-C fast charging, and a built-in microphone for hands-free calls. It also includes FM radio, voice assistant support, and IPX5 splash resistance, in a metallic fabric finish with a detachable lanyard.

products.name: ICY-I Chill You
products.description: A compact, handheld portable fan with an instant cooling feature that uses a semiconductor cooling plate to create a chilled sensation of up to 18°C. It has four airflow speeds driven by a 14,000+ RPM brushless motor and a 4000mAh rechargeable battery that runs up to 12 hours on low speed. A smart LED display shows battery, speed, and cooling status, and the fan runs under 30dB for quiet use. It charges over USB-C in about 1.5 hours and includes a lanyard for hands-free travel.

products.name: Elite 45W GaN3
products.description: A compact 45W wall charger with two USB-C ports, built on GaN3 (Gallium Nitride) technology for laptops and smartphones. It splits output as 25W and 20W across the ports and supports PPS fast charging. The maker claims it runs cooler and charges up to three times faster than ordinary chargers. At about 72 grams with a universal 100-250V input and six layers of safety protection, it is aimed at travellers and everyday use, and it is made in India.

products.name: Booster Pro 20K
products.description: The Tempt Booster Pro 20K is a 20,000mAh power bank that supports 22.5W fast charging over one USB-C and two USB-A ports, so it can charge up to three devices at once. It supports several charging protocols, including PD 3.0 and QC 3.0, and has a digital LED display that shows the battery percentage. The product also includes 12 layers of safety protection and is BIS certified. It is aimed at travel, daily use, and emergency backup.

products.name: JOOS Mag 5K
products.description: The Joos Mag 5K is an ultra-slim 5000mAh power bank, about 8.7mm thick, that snaps magnetically onto iPhones via MagSafe for 15W wireless charging. It also offers a 22.5W PD wired output that can fast-charge Android devices, and it can charge two devices at once. The metal-finished unit is lightweight and designed for travel and daily use, and it is made in India.

products.name: Electramax
products.description: A compact 48W car charger with two ports, one USB-C and one USB-A, that supports Quick Charge and Power Delivery so two devices can charge at once. It includes short-circuit, over-voltage, and over-current protection and is designed to work with smartphones, tablets, and Bluetooth speakers. It weighs 30g and is sold with cash on delivery and free shipping.

products.name: Juggler
products.description: The Tempt Juggler is a portable Bluetooth speaker with detachable TWS earbuds that can be used as a speaker or as personal earphones. Its 52mm drivers are designed for deep bass and clear, room-filling sound, and it connects over Bluetooth 5.1 (speaker) and 5.3 (earbuds). It weighs about 350 g, has a 1200 mAh battery for roughly 4 hours of playback, and supports TF card and AUX input.

products.name: Thunder Pro
products.description: Tempt Thunder Pro is a pair of gaming earbuds with Bluetooth 6.0 connectivity and a 45ms Game Mode intended to keep audio closely in sync with on-screen action. They use 13mm bass drivers, offer custom EQ modes and touch controls, and have dual-mic noise reduction for calls. The earbuds are IPX5 rated for sweat and water resistance, provide about 7 hours of playback, and include a charging case with USB-C fast charging.

products.name: Cinebar 24W
products.description: The TEMPT Cinebar 24W is a Bluetooth soundbar for TV with 2.0-channel sound, 24W output, dual 52mm bass drivers, and dual bass radiators. It offers up to 8 hours of playback from a 4000mAh battery, which recharges via Type-C in about 3 hours. Connectivity includes Bluetooth 5.4 with TWS pairing, plus USB, TF card, and AUX inputs. It also has music-synced RGB lights and a built-in microphone for hands-free calls.

products.name: Wave Pro
products.description: The Tempt Wave Pro is a pair of true wireless Bluetooth earbuds with a premium electroplated finish and 13 mm bass drivers for deep sound. It advertises up to 72 hours of playback, about 120 hours of standby, and Type-C fast charging to a full charge in about an hour. It also offers a 65 ms low-latency mode for gaming, HD calling with a built-in mic, Bluetooth 5.3, touch controls with Siri or Google Assistant support, and IPX6 water resistance.

products.name: Rebel
products.description: The Rebel is a portable 12W Bluetooth party speaker with 360 degree sound, RGB lighting, FM radio, and TWS pairing for stereo sound with a second unit. It has an IPX5 water-resistant body, up to 10 hours of playtime from a 1200mAh battery, and a built-in mobile holder and microphone for hands-free calls. It also plays from Bluetooth 5.3, FM, USB pendrive, or SD card, and is sold in black and blue.
products.dimensions: 4.2 W x 6 H x 3.2 D inch

products.name: Elite Travel X Slim 67W GaN3
products.description: This is a compact 67W dual-port USB-C charger built on GaN3 technology, designed to charge both phones and laptops. Its ultra-slim, lightweight body is aimed at travelers and comes with a 1.5m Type-C cable and an Indian pin plug. The page lists it as BIS safety certified and compatible with a wide range of devices.

products.name: Elite Globe Slim 67W GaN3
products.description: The Elite Globe Slim 67W GaN3 is a compact travel charger designed to work in over 190 countries and with a wide range of devices. It supports 67W fast charging through its dual USB-C ports and uses GaN3 technology, with built-in safety protection. The charger is lightweight, BIS safety certified, and marketed as one of the slimmest travel chargers available.

products.name: Mag Mount
products.description: The MagMount is a magnetic car phone holder that uses vacuum suction to attach to dashboards, windshields, consoles, and glass. It rotates 360 degrees and tilts 180 degrees, so it works for GPS navigation, hands-free calls, and media viewing in portrait or landscape. It includes a 3M adhesive metal plate for Android and non-MagSafe phones and is heat resistant. It can also be used at home, in the kitchen, or in an office.

products.name: Privee Fusion
products.description: The Privee Fusion is a 4-in-1 bedside and desk device that combines a Bluetooth speaker, a clock, a 15W wireless charging pad, and an alarm with a stand. It has dual 40mm drivers rated at 16W, RGB lighting with 12 modes, and a built-in FM radio with hands-free calling. It offers three nature preset sounds, customizable alarms, and about 7 hours of playback from a 1200mAh battery.

products.name: Flexi Pro
products.description: The Flexi Pro is a foldable aluminum stand for desks, countertops, and bedside tables that holds smartphones, tablets, and e-readers. It rotates 360 degrees, has an extendable height, and can be set to many viewing angles. Anti-skid pads on the base keep the device from slipping. The stand is compact and portable enough to carry in a bag.

products.name: Konekt
products.description: The KONEKT 60W Multi-Functional Accessory Kit is a compact, pocket-sized travel kit that combines 60W Fast PD charging with multiple connectors, including Type-C, USB-A, Lightning, and Micro USB. It has a retractable Type-C cable, a built-in mobile stand, and storage slots for SIM, TF, and SD cards. A tech cleaning kit for keyboards, ports, and screens is included, all housed in a durable ABS case. It is available in Black and White.

products.name: Trigo
products.description: Trigo is a 15W wireless charger that combines a MagSafe-compatible charging pad, a slim PU leather wallet that holds up to three cards plus cash, and a foldable hands-free phone stand. Its 3800 GS magnetic grip keeps phones secure, and an included magnetic ring adds MagSafe support to non-MagSafe phones. The wallet allows tap-and-go contactless payments without removing cards. It comes in black and brown, with a charger, user manual, magnetic ring, and cable in the box.

products.name: Privee Lunar
products.description: The Privee Lunar is a 4-in-1 Bluetooth speaker that also works as a night lamp, aroma diffuser, and home decor piece, with a transparent moon-inspired design. It has an 8W speaker with a 57mm bass driver, Bluetooth 5.4 connectivity, and a Type-C charging port. An 1800mAh battery offers up to 40 hours of playback, and the built-in diffuser works with essential oils. It has two soft ambient light modes and can be used independently as a lamp.

products.name: Cameo
products.description: The Tempt Cameo is a pocket-sized, ultra-lightweight Bluetooth speaker with a 6W output and a 40mm driver, tuned for deep bass and clear highs. It uses Bluetooth 5.3 with a 10-meter range, supports TWS pairing for stereo sound, and includes a built-in microphone for calls, plus TF card playback. Its magnetic design and lanyard make it easy to attach or carry, and its transparent body has RGB lights. A 600mAh battery offers up to 6 hours of playback and Type-C charging.

products.name: Elite 30W GaN3
products.description: The Elite 30W GaN3 charger is a compact single-port USB-C adapter that delivers up to 30W and supports PD, PPS 3.0, SFC, FCP, and SCP fast-charging protocols. It uses a GaN III chipset for efficiency and lower heat, with multi-layer protection against over-current, over-voltage, over-temperature, overload, and short circuits. The charger accepts universal AC input (100V-250V, 50/60Hz) and is marketed as a lightweight, travel-friendly option that works with phones, tablets, earbuds, power banks, and smartwatches.

products.name: Zoom
products.description: The Zoom X1 is a wired sports earphone for gym workouts, running, and jogging. It has a universal 3.5mm jack and a 12mm bass driver for punchy sound, plus passive noise isolation. A built-in microphone supports calls, and EarHooks with three silicone ear tip sizes help it stay secure during activity. It works with phones, tablets, laptops, and desktops, and comes in black and red.

products.name: Booster
products.description: The Booster is a compact 10000mAh power bank with a lithium polymer battery, built with a slim, pocket-sized design for travel or daily use. It supports two-way fast charging, so it can charge itself and a connected device at the same time. Dual USB outputs let you charge two devices simultaneously, and it works with phones, tablets, and earbuds. Multi-layer protection guards against overcharge, overcurrent, overheating, and short circuits.

products.name: Verge Pro X
products.description: The Verge Pro X is an Always On Display smartwatch with a 2.04-inch IPS touch screen and a rotating digital crown for navigation. It offers multiple customizable watch faces, Bluetooth calling with a built-in microphone and speaker, and a built-in voice assistant. It supports 60+ sports modes and real-time fitness tracking, and it is water- and sweat-resistant. It is compatible with iOS and Android and has wireless charging.

products.name: JOOS Mag 10K
products.description: The Joos Mag 10k is a 10000mAh magnetic power bank marketed as ultra-slim, at about 14mm thick, with an aerospace-grade metal body. It charges MagSafe-compatible iPhones wirelessly at 15W and offers a 22.5W PD wired output, so it can charge a second device at the same time. It includes LED charge indicators, supports pass-through charging, and is positioned as travel-friendly and BIS certified.

products.name: Cult Pro ANC
products.description: The Cult Pro is a wireless true-wireless earbud with up to 32dB Active Noise Cancellation and a Transparency Mode for staying aware of surroundings. It uses 13mm dynamic bass drivers tuned with Tempt's OxyAcoustics sound, and it offers up to 8 hours of playback per charge, or 60 hours with the case. A quad-mic system supports clear calls, and Bluetooth 5.3 with 65ms low latency suits gaming and streaming. It is IPX5 rated for sweat and water resistance, with Type-C fast charging.

products.name: Booster Pro 10K
products.description: The Booster Pro 10K is a 10,000mAh lithium-ion power bank with 22.5W fast charging, sold as a way to charge three devices at once. It has one Type-C and two USB-A outputs, each rated at 22.5W. It includes a digital LED that shows battery level from 0 to 100%, and a 12-layer safety system covering overcharge, over-voltage, over-current, short circuits, and heat. It's pitched for phones, tablets, earbuds, smartwatches, and neckbands, and is described as compact and travel-friendly. The page also claims 0 to 15% charge in about 7 minutes and 20% to 80% in about 40 minutes. The product is BIS certified and made in India.

products.name: Groove Pro
products.description: The Groove Pro is a wireless Bluetooth neckband with Bluetooth 5.2, up to 45 hours of playtime, and Type-C charging. It has ENC calling microphones and IPX5 water and sweat resistance, and it uses a 200 mAh battery with 3 on-device control buttons. The earphones weigh 18 g, and the box includes a Type-C cable.

A snap-on, snap-off phone holder fits a wide range of smartphones and can be adjusted for low-angle, overhead, or centered selfies. The box contains the stick, the remote, and the detachable holder.

Featuring a multi-textured quilted design, it offers a premium, modern look with reliable laptop protection. The padded interior keeps your device safe from scratches and impacts, while the quick-access pocket stores essentials like chargers, cables, and notebooks. Designed for travel ease, it includes a trolley sleeve, slide-in handle, and detachable shoulder strap for multiple carry options. Sleek, durable, and versatile, perfect for men and women on the go.
products.dimensions: Dimensions (cm) : 36cmx 25cm x 7cm(L x W x H)
